concert_PackageRecommendation.recommenda.justification: Recommendation_id and actionID both seem to be unique identifiers for actions or recommendations, making them conceptually related.
Recommendation_id could also be related to actionImpactID as both might serve as identifiers for actions or their impacts.

concert_PackageRecommendation.created_da.justification: Created_date and createTime both refer to the timestamp when an action or recommendation was created, linking them directly.
Created_date could also relate to the last update time of an action or recommendation, thus it is conceptually related to updateTime.
Created_date and clearTime could both be timestamps associated with actions or recommendations, making them related.

concert_PackageRecommendation.descriptio.justification: Description and details both provide additional information about an action or recommendation, thus they are conceptually related.

concert_PackageRecommendation.action.justification: Action and externalActionName both refer to the type or name of an action, making them conceptually related.
